name: Sparse Voxel Octree CPU Rasterizer
definition: A CPU-based rasterizer that traverses a Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) to render voxels into a color buffer, using depth-sorted traversal and hierarchical culling (rectangles vs points).
summary: A CPU-based rasterizer that traverses a Sparse Voxel Octree to render voxels directly into a color buffer, distinguishing itself by performing the entire pipeline on the CPU using flat node arrays and explicit stack management.
